DID WELL
+ 26 minutes on the pitch, zero quit.

WORK ON

- 2.1 below usual. No panic, just practice.

Practice pointer: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso
